items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: That was Willie. Willie or Lush, neither one. They were two years difference. I was either one or the other. And they were in all kind of mischief.

ctx.x: did you recognize any of the guys later? Oh, later on I got to know them like, for instance, like

Black Nolan, Buckeye Wilford. What did they play? They played piano. All these were piano players? They played the blues, yeah, piano players. Black Nolan, Buckeye Wilford. Yeah, they were always welcome. Shine, regular hunky-tunk piano players. First time I heard what it's called now Boogie Woogie. The first time I heard that beat, my little uncle said, look at that guy playing them horses. He used to call it the horses in New Orleans. It wasn't Boogie Woogie, it was horses, because it sounded like a horse's…
Go ahead, it's ready Danny on the second reel.
